name: refinement-array-returns-capacity
description: Behaviour-changing rewrite of layout::array: the Err arm returns Error::Capacity instead of Error::Layout. VeriFast's spec allows any owned Error, so only the refinement checker can reject it.

name: verifast-array-spec-count-below-5
description: Strengthened postcondition of layout::array (Ok implies count < 5), false for most counts.

name: verifast-capacity-invariant-dropped
description: The ownership predicate of Capacity<T> no longer carries the byte bound; Capacity::layout must then fail to prove its postcondition.
old: pred<T> <Capacity<T>>.own(t, c) = std::alloc::is_valid_layout(c.count.0 * std::mem::size_of::<T>(), std::mem::align_of::<T>()) == true;

name: strip-non-comment-edit
description: A non-comment edit (#[inline] -> #[inline(never)]) in the annotations-only file capacity.rs. The comment-strip check and the refinement checker must both reject it.

name: identity-product-changed
description: A one-character edit to a temporary copy of src/capacity.rs. The identity check must fail, which is the signal to re-review the proof.
